stated: The Conservative Party will extend its Community Ownership Fund to help more communities across the UK take control of vital local assets like pubs, music venues, libraries, green spaces, and leisure centres.

source.quote: Extend our Community Ownership Fund to help more communities across the UK take control of vital community assets like pubs, music venues, libraries, green spaces, leisure centres and more.

bearing_set.reason: Explicitly includes libraries and community learning spaces; preserving these assets through community ownership maintains access to educational and skills resources, particularly for lower-income communities who rely on them most.

Community ownership of pubs, music venues, libraries, green spaces and leisure centres directly targets social trust, civic participation and local belonging — the core indicators of O15 — by keeping shared community hubs in community hands rather than allowing closure or private acquisition.

membership_note: The policy is single-target: its entire design is to preserve and transfer control of community social infrastructure, which maps cleanly and non-negligibly onto O15. Green spaces could weakly gesture at O6, but the mechanism (ownership transfer rather than environmental management) and the modest fund scale make any environmental effect incidental rather than material. Fiscal cost (O12) exists but is sub-threshold at this fund's historic scale (~£150m). No other fundamental earns a non-negligible verdict.
